text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Nishino Flower and I are on
our way
back from shopping, when...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! It looks like they're holding the
raffle
over there!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wow! All the prizes are incredible! The
worker at
the grocery store wasn't
kidding!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I only have one ticket and one chance.
Just like in
a race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The grocery store worker from earlier
actually offered Nishino Flower a
hundred raffle tickets,
but she politely
declined.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you wanna give it a try? Here's
hoping you
get a good prize!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! And yes, I'd like to try my
luck,
please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower gives the raffle machine's
lever a
vigorous spin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand prize winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wow!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wooow!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I got the grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring vacation... That feels like
such a
grown-up thing to go to.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh... That's right. I'm still too young to
go alone...
choice_data_list: It might be best to go with your g...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'll ask my parents. And, um...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me? Can this coupon be used for
four
people?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
I should think so!
I'll check for you later!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! That means you can come
too,
Trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I've never been to a hot spring before...
but
adults like that kind of thing, right?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Those who like hot springs
reeeally like
them.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That makes sense! Is this hot spring nice?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
It sure is! I've got someone in my family
who's really picky about hot springs, but
they've given
that one their seal of
approval!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That's great! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Now I definitely want you to come,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'd really like to go to such a nice place
with you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but that's only if you want to, of
course...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's just,
I think it'll definitely be more
fun with
you there!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So please come!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you've got to go! How can you
refuse
such a heartfelt request?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Nishino Flower and I make a
promise to
go on vacation together once
things aren't so
busy.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wow! What a fancy hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Just thinking about eating it is
making me
excited.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yup! My mom always made them for me
when I
did well on a test or won a race.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
To me, hamburger steaks are filled with
love and
kindness...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It is! What about you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've eaten them both on
special and regular days, but I can't
really remember. I'm
always so busy that
it all blurs together.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, if you'd like, why don't we split this

hamburger steak?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
We can have it to commemorate winning
first
prize in the raffle!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And from now on, I'll make us a bunch of

hamburger steaks whenever something
good
happens!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Actually, it doesn't have to be
hamburger steaks.
I'll make you
whatever you want, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll help you make all kinds of special
memories
that you can think back fondly
on! ♪

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wow! Look at all these carrots!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
They're all firm, and the roots are nice
and evenly
spread. They look sweet,
too. ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm pretty confident when it
comes to
judging fruits and vegetables!
choice_data_list: You've got a discerning eye, don't...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I help out at home, I get put
in charge
of picking ingredients at the
shops. ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, my parents always got
so happy
whenever the employees at the
supermarket
praised me...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Their smiles would be so big and warm.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I always did my best when picking, since
I wanted
to see those smiles.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You do?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh! Mom! Dad! Can you see me okay?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, great! My trainer's holding my
phone right
now.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Did you get dinner ready as well? It
might be
through a screen, but let's eat
together
tonight! ♪

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's so cute... ♪

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Sorry you didn't get a bigger prize. I
hope you're
not disappointed.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! I mean, just look at how
delicious this
carrot looks!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It may be small, but it's such a lovely
orange
color. I bet it'll be great
stewed. ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Are you free tonight, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If you are, I say we warm ourselves up
with some
carrot soup! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a very cold night, but Nishino
Flower's homemade carrot soup keeps
both our hearts and
bodies nice and
toasty.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Aww...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No, not at all!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Now I can give anyone a tissue when
they need
one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At first, Nishino Flower doesn't seem
upset, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I bet Trainer would've been really happy
if I won the
grand prize...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I really wish I had won it...
